mapper.sql: tr.id, tr.name, tr.type, tr.path, tr.teacher_id, tr.course_id, tr.upload_time, tr.description, tr.size, tr.downloads
mapper.insert: insert into teaching_resource (name, type, path, teacher_id, course_id, upload_time, description, size, downloads) values (#{name}, #{type}, #{path}, #{teacherId}, #{courseId}, #{uploadTime}, #{description}, #{size}, #{downloads})
mapper.update: update teaching_resource set downloads = downloads + 1 where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select , t.name as teacherName, c.name as courseName from teaching_resource tr left join teacher t on tr.teacher_id = t.id left join course c on tr.course_id = c.id where tr.id = #{id}
